[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 22 October 2026.

[2026-10-22_QNT]  
Video Title: Quant ($QNT) Accumulation Analysis🚀  
Video ID: 4-KSzHdwkGc  
Quant (QNT) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
• Current trading price sits around $180–$200, roughly 4× the 20‑week SMA of $100–$120.  
• Composite risk score exceeds 230, with a 78% risk level when the price is 2× the SMA.  
• 90‑day ROI of 163% and 90‑day volatility are high, while trend quality is slightly below 50%, yet relative momentum remains very strong.  
• Social‑sentiment word‑cloud shows a surge in “euphoria” tags, aligning with the recent 90‑day ROI spike.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• TWAP baseline is anchored near the regression fair‑value band at $45, with the current price at $180, indicating a 400% premium.  
• The asset has breached the 3‑sigma regression ceiling and is now approaching the 95% confidence channel, suggesting a potential re‑entry to the fair‑value band.  
• Undervaluation/overvaluation residuals: price is 50% above the one‑year volume‑weighted average price of $130, and 80% above the time‑weighted average of $80.  
• Composite risk remains high (>230) but has moderated to 78% as the deviation from the 20‑week SMA has subsided to 2×.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• ML forecast for the next 10 weeks projects a floor at $55 (non‑panic) and a panic floor near $110.  
• Short‑term support likely around $130 (one‑standard‑deviation channel) and a potential bounce to the $120 SMA level if momentum holds.  
• Long‑term cycle bull targets: higher highs/lows projected for 2024–2025, with a possible late‑2026 rally driven by fundamentals; 2028 extrapolation suggests a 50% increase from the $80 baseline to roughly $120.  
• If the price remains above the 20‑week SMA, the model expects a gradual convergence toward the fair‑value band, potentially reaching the $140 mark before a new cycle.

[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 17 October 2026.

[2026-10-17_QNT]  
Video Title: Quant ($QNT) Accumulation Analysis🚀  
Video ID: 3Hxp569aHh8  
Quant (QNT) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
The asset is trading near $350.6, having surged from $60 to $350.6 in a few weeks, and sits just above the lifetime time‑average price (purple line). Composite risk is slightly above 230, raw gravity at 63, and volatility is very high, with trend quality around 60 and relative momentum at 100 %. Social sentiment is in an euphoria zone, with 90‑day momentum at 217 % and a 90‑day rally of 117 % for the leader.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
TWAP baselines are implied by the 90‑day rally; the asset has moved beyond the three‑standard‑deviation regression band, indicating a high TWAP risk level. The regression channel top is near $17 k, while the bottom sits at the purple line, creating an undervaluation residual zone of roughly 170 % above the lifetime average. Market premium has fallen from 285 % to 170 % above the purple line, and the one‑year volume‑weighted average price is now $27, up sharply from $80 in early September 2026.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
ML models flag a potential downside floor at a 20 % drawdown from the peak, with risk level one suggesting a 60 % drop from the white line as a worst‑case scenario. Upside targets include a 75‑call at $2378 and a near‑term rally of about $220 over the next week, pushing the price toward the regression channel top. The cycle bull target remains the 90‑day rally of 217 %, with a long‑term upside potentially reaching the $350.6 peak if fundamentals justify the growth.
